reviews.review_description: Price wasn’t the biggest motivation for us in choosing Energy Base (most of the prices were fairly similar) Energy Base were the only company to offer the sungrow PV changeover switch while others said it couldn’t be done.Energy Base were very professional all the way through from salesman to final install, absolutely beautiful install by their full time(not contractors) technicians ,and was also installed earlier than the original proposed date. Couldn’t be happier ,highly recommend this company.

Energy base were prompt to contact me & booking an initial appointment to discuss our needs was smooth. The information process to suit our needs made sense & Energy Base made a concerted effort to fit us in, in a timely manner for installation

Sales very good no pressure and good advice on type of system we wantedInstallation was very good even being a man down good work ethicEnergy Base have organized the grid connection which is happening in a couple of weeks
Peter C is a great help ... highly recommend Energy Base !!
As above. Only negative was that only 2 installers out of 3 quotes requested ever made contact. In end did not miss them.
Such an easy process with Energy Base, quality tradesmen and kept informed at all times

Their quoting process was simple and easy to understand. The installation went well. Started and finished on time. Very polite technicians. They explained the operation of the system well.  Very neat workmanship. They arranged all the necessary details with the electricity supplier.
The weather was bad, but the  Energybase boys turned up on time and did what they could. They worked with me to organise a time that suited me to finish the job. Very happy
All good so far

Thank you Energy Base, you made the whole solar minefield a walk in the park.  The Salesman who I dealt with was the utmost professional, and also the only person who made the effort to climb on my roof and check the installation conditions!  The installation itself went smoothly, the guys did the hard work, I supplied the coffee!  Grid connection is booked in soon, job done.  Thanks again Energy Base. Have already passed your details on to some friends.

Great service and expert advise. Local family owned company with a professional and knowledgeable team. Thanks again for your hard work boys- install was superb. Neat and tidy and went that extra mile.

Great to deal with a local company who offer exceptional service. Peter had no problems in modifying my quotation after the initial consult to change around to suit our needs. Installation was completed easily without hassle from the professional team, including setup of the Fronius inverter application on our smartphones for live tracking. The system has been performing well as advised - highly recommend Engery Base.

From when Bob from Energy Base came to give me a quote to installation was vey professional. The date was given and they were here early as we had an appointment that day,  everything was installed and working by lunch. The crew cleaned up any rubbish. Very tidy.  Everything was organised for grid connection by Energy Base. Would highly recommend them for any Solar installation.

My son in Sydney recommended your services in order to obtain a quality, qualified and professional supplier.He was 'spot on'.We could not be happier. The placement of the panels is pulling excellent solar results, the tradesmen were polite, respectful and reliable. The company was supportive through all steps of the process.I have many times confidently recommended the Information Pages you supply Finn. I would like shares in your company! :)

Very impressed with the professional service that we received from the moment Bob walked through the door to the installation by the locally owned business. The installers are tradesmen in their fields and are employed by the business. The work was carried out as per quoted timeframe as well as product choice. All third party involvement was arranged with no complications to complete the job. Follow up from the business meant any issues that may have been outstanding would have been dealt with. All in all very happy with all aspects of the install. Highly recommend this local solar installation business cheers Peter
Fantastic and polite people to deal with would highly recommend :)

Salesman was very knowledgeable and honest.Installation was completed 4 weeks earlier than expected. Team were punctual and polite. Job was completed in 1 day and left the site tidy.Customer service was excellent. Grid connection was arranged by Energy Base but we are still waiting for Ergon.

quote was very competitive salesman was lovely not pushyinstallation was done very politely, very punctual, very tidy and pleasant hard working young mengrid connection is all set up just waiting for Ergon to appear now
Very professional, easy to organise installation, prompt and helpful staff great price

The salesman came to our home and measured up, working out the best position for our panels.  Recommendation was made to have our roof re-screwed which we organised through an independent contractor. The quote was supplied and presented in a professional way. The 2 guys who did the installation were polite and organised. They arrived as arranged and when finished, cleaned up and took all rubbish. Energy Base did the paperwork associated with grid connection, which saved us the hassle.  We anticipate we will be connected to the grid within the next week or so, dependant on Ergon.

Energy Base where very knowledgeable about all things Solar, at first I wanted a Tesla Power wall but they explained the payback time on the outlay will take 17 years at current prices.So I ended up deciding on a 6.6kw of LG330 solar panels with an SMA Inverter.I'm also using Solar Analytics as my motioning program I could not be happier with all the products.

The customer service has been good so far although the installation started later than anticipated and did appear to be rushed, especially the explaining on how things worked with the equipment as this was done on near dark. The actual installation of equipment does appear to be very good however. The website monitoring is very good but we are not hooked up to the electricity provider yet so I guess too early to to say how efficient the system is.
We are extremely happy with the service, the system and the awesome savings. Thanks Bob, and Thanks Energy Base.

I Would Highly Recommend Energy Base Mackay.I Spoke with Bob Jocelyn on the 28th May about installing a Solar System, and he explained all aspects of the system, and how we would be able to reduce our power bill by utilising the Power that the System Produces, and the 24/7 Back to Base Consumption Monitoring. (We are NOW able to see how & when we are using our power - The Monitoring even shows up in the graphing, when we turn on our Kettle)We installed a 10kW System which was made up of 34 REC Twin Peak Solar Panels, and a 8.2kW Fronius Primo Inverter. We also incorporated the use of a Hot Water Timer to allow us to use the energy produced by the Solar System during the daytime, which should give us a Massive Saving on our Hot Water Power Bill, as we Love having Long Hot Showers all year round.We were due to be installed within 4-5 weeks, but we asked Bob if our installation could be fast tracked if there were any cancellations. We ended up getting our System Installed earlier than anticipated due to a cancellation on the 5-6th June.The Installers contacted us to introduce themselves the day before the Installation, and advised us of the Time that they would be arriving at our home the next morning.Upon arrival, The Installers confirmed the positioning of the Panels & the Inverter, and then they went about their duties in a Professional Manner.We were Very Happy with the Quality, the Professionalism, the Courtesy, and the Cleanliness of the workers.So far, we are wrapped with how we have been able to Monitor and fine tune our habits and usage to Fully utilise the power that we are producing from the sun.Great Work Energy Base, and once again thanks Bob.

Even though I have rated  Customer service as fantastic.. that is my immediate perception and I should say I don't think it will change.The only thing I get concerned with is the volatility of the industry, turnover of company's.Regards,Barry Ezzy
Highly recommend energy base

Only sales person who went on the roof to check, only sales person to look at the main switch board.Good advice, understood what I wanted but could also explain what I needed.(initially I wanted a 10 KW system with battery storage, turned out to be way too expensive and the earn back period would be too long)
When they said the system would be installed it was .

Bob spent a lot of time explaining things to us - more than any other company did. He patiently answered many questions (and we asked a lot - probably more than most people), on several occasions. We did not feel pressured into making a rushed decision. In the end, we confidently made a fully informed decision and knew exactly what we were getting and what was involved in the installation from start to finish.

It was a pleasure dealing with the entire team from Salesmen, installation team and administration team. I was advised 4 weeks before the installation date that the team would be at my house at 7:30am and they were at my house at the right date and time. The staff were very well dressed and mannered.
Highly recommend using energy base, very neat and professional.

I found energy base very good to deal with. The team was professional and friendly. The install was neat and was good to see was clean when they left. I would recommend energy base to anyone. Very happy!

Excellent customer service from first initial meeting with an extremely informative salesperson who clearly knew the industry and products AND most importantly went out of his way to educate us on several options we could invest in, and then the quality of work on install was excellent to say the least!

The Team at Energy Base Mackay have gone over and beyond in regards to service,The installation team where Quick, Efficient, Neat, and extremely Professional!And the sales team where very informative, great communication, and extremely polite!I wish I had of met Bob sooner!The savings are unbelievable!
Everthing that was planed over the phone happened on time and as described.

Very upfront and honest with what would suit your lifestyle. Our house has a tiled roof and they were very professional, friendly serviced and careful when installing the panels.  Very efficient and finished within a day. I would highly recommend this company to anyone looking to install solar panels.
Very good job, pleased with all aspects of the job
No pressure tactics, friendly service from Bob.  The whole process went smoothly and without any issues. Definitely a premium product and quality service.

Energy Base provided a range of solar panel, inverter and battery options upfront for us to compare. The quote provided was comprehensive and included all the details and links to allow us to make an informed decision. All questions we had throughout the entire process were promptly answered. The LG Neon2 panel was the key item that put Energy Base ahead of the competition. Compared to the other panels available, the LG panels had the best efficiency, greatest wind resistance, slowest degradation rate and longest product warranty by far. The installation process was smooth and the handover of the system at the end was excellent. We've also really enjoyed the Fronius online monitoring system which provides us with live generation and consumption data and a range of analysis tools for us to optimise our energy usage.

I would Highly Recommend Energy Base to anyone looking at purchasing a Solar System.Bobs knowledge in helping me to understand Solar and the workings of the System was Impressive.He was conservative with his Savings calculations, and I have seen a dramatic change in my 1st power bill, going from $548 down to $203. This was from Summer moving into Autumn.The Installers were on time and completed the job to my satisfaction, and left the site clean and tidy.I enjoy using the SolaX Wifi Monitoring, as it helps give direction in sshowing me where I should change my power usage habits to save energy and money.I give Energybase 5 out of 5 for Service, Satisfaction, & Procedure.Brian BucktonGlenella Qld

My experience with Energy base Mackay was excellent from start to finish. I was especially impressed with the workmanship of their installers. Could not fault anything they did, and i'm very fussy. Thanks Energy Base????
Very happy with product & service. Kept us informed on install dates etc. System is working beyond expectations
I am very happy with the system. Delivering as expected.  Solar is Analytics fantastic and gives me great information on my electricity usage and my system performance.
Quality job with great communication from company. Great explanation of how to use system to best reduce power bills

I would recommend Energy Base for solar. The salesman Bob was friendly and knowledgeable. The installers Eben and Akeem were very efficient and friendly, and always cleaned up after themselves. Very satisfied with the service . The monitoring is very helpful for helping us to understand where we are using the power at all times throughout the day. Good Job Energy Base - We Highly recommend You.

I really can't fault Energy Base at any stage from start to finish. With Brendon's experience we were soon able to design a system of suitable size and quality. The installation crew did a first class job and left the place as clean as they found it. Their care and attention to detail was obvious in the neatness of the finished job. If you are thinking of getting a solar system installed I would highly recommend the team at Energy Base.

Energy Base offered a good range of products and were flexible working around our renovations. We felt like Energy Base did their best to personally endeavor to have the system meet our needs and were prompt in performing final calibration when we requested it.

Top bunch of guys with a good reputation. Were fantastic on the day battling through 40C heat in the middle of summer and never complained about it once. Excellent from the first inquiry through to even today. They answer any query straight up and couldnt be anymore helpful. Could recommend Energy Base to anyone interested in a high quality system with the best service available.
Salesman Bob gave a full comprehensive overview of the system and install process, whilst the installers were prompt, polite and did a quality job.

We would recommend Energy Base Mackay to anybody who is looking for a great solar experience, great customer service, Bob presented the product with professionalism, knowledge & we received exactly what we had discussed. Well done.

Did months of research prior to choosing solar, and every question I had was answered honestly by Brendan and the team. Entire process was spot on and continued support even months after install is second to none.

Energy Base gave clear and honest advice on the options available and stuck to the time frames they promised for installation. They catered for our preferences for panel locations and completed the job efficiently. They have also been excellent with after sales advice and help.

My experience with Energy Base went well from the initial consultation with Bob the Salesperson, right through to the end of Installation, and with the job follow-up. Brendan himself even came over on a weekend to tweak the system as he had found something in the monitoring.Energy Base provided good advice, they were honest and they completed the job on time.The quality of the installation was professional, and the Installers were courteous, professional, and left the site clean.I am impressed with the consumption monitoring. I can see where all of my loads are working throughout the day, and have been able to make adjustments that will help save me money on my power bill from the get go.I would Highly Recommend Energy Base to anyone wishing to Purchase a Solar System for the Advice, Price and the Quality of the System and Installation.Thanks Again Energy BaseMark S â€“ North Mackay

Energy Base were Fantastic.Our initial enquiry was immediately followed up by the Salesperson Bob who provided our quote promptly. He was also very responsive to the queries that we had. The installers came at the time and date we organised and finished the same day, so there was minimal hassel. The after sales service and follow up has been great and we are very happy with the system. We only had the system installed recently but so far have had no issues at all.Matt and Katrina

Extremely pleased with the service we received from Brendan and the team at Energy Base, from the sales guy right through to the install crew. Could not find fault in anything they did, totally professional in everything they did. The install team did a very tidy job which I was very impressed with, not your normal tradies.

The Service that I received from Energy Base from start to Finish was exemplary. Bob was very Informative, and was able to talk Solar to me in terms that I was able to understand.He never overpromised, or overstated the Features & Benefits of what the Solar System was going to do for our Household. In fact he Underpromised and has Overdelivered.The Installers (Eben & Co) were Great.They called me to let me know when they were coming, they arrived on time, and they were Very Courteous, Professional, Neat and Tidy with the job that they did on our installation.The whole Experience with Energy Base was just FantasticThanks Again Energy Base ????
Thanks to the team at Energy Base for not only delivering a professional service but a quality installation and approachable, friendly and knowledgeable staff.  We are extremely grateful.
Energy Base were very helpful and patient while I shopped around and clearly tried to get the best deal I could.

The only thing that i,am not happy with is, your are not told about a .09 lagging from the electric company which makes my 3.2 kw system run 10% lower than what you pay for . Doing the calculations on this I found out the system should be running at about just under 2.9kw anyway, was told not to use system until Ergon came around to put another meter in, but ran system for about an hour so i could see it working. System was running at around 3kw. next day energy base came around and put lagging on inverter, now its flat out running at around 2.7kw not happy as this system even with Ergons lagging of 10% should still be running 2.8kw to 2.9kw so you don,t get what you actually pay for
Brendan has been in constant contact with me and even continues to monitor our system after it has been installed.Couldn't speak highly enough of the service from Brendan at Energy Base

Energy Base provided fantastic, friendly, easy going service.The systems are top quality and although I may have been a bit difficult to pin down as I work away, Energy Base fitted in wonderfully with my R&R's for the installation.Thanks Energy Base and Solar Quotes.
We have only had our system in for 2 weeks.  The service and follow up has been wonderful.  We have been happy to recommend this company.  Time will tell with the power bill

A high standard of installation and protection of switch boxes on the roof with aluminum covers. Installation neatness was another factor I was happy with and the way the tradesman tidy up there mess was of a high standard.

Brendan, Jennifer and the guys at EnergyBase Mackay were absolutely fantastic! From quote to installation to after sales service, they really knew their stuff. They were friendly, efficient and we did not encounter any problems at all. Well recommended!
I wish we had of done this earlier
Energy Base were great to deal with; they are professional, friendly, knowledgeable and efficient.  Helpful in providing advice and options to suit our needs.  I would definitely recommend them.

We had a great experience using Energy Base as our Solar Installer. Brendan was very professional in his dealings and kept us up to date with everything along the way. He answered all our questions throughout the process and was extremely friendly.The quality of the install was very good. Everything looks very neat and tidy with a professional finish.We had a 5Kw system installed and used an SMA Inverter and Trina Panels. If you do your research, you will know that these are top of the range with a great reputation. Be careful with other companies who are using unknown named equipment. For something that should last a couple of decades, we decided to go for a quality brand.It has been almost 6 months since Energy Base installed a solar system at our house. Everything is still going really well. The system is generating some good numbers and our first power bill is half of what it was - $550 (down from $1100 - lots of air con!!)A couple of months ago there was a news article about an Australia wide recall on some solar electrical parts. I was about to write Brendan an email to ask if this affected me, but he beat me to it. He was courteous enough to let me know that Energy Base didn't use this brand of electrical equipment. What great customer service!! I am so glad I went with a local company.Since I had my system installed, my mum had Energy Base install a 5Kw system at her place. She had a very similar experience with Brendan and Energy Base.I would highly recommend Energy Base to anyone in the Mackay region. I would happily use them again if I have any future Solar installs. Hopefully when the Solar Battery systems get cheaper, I will be calling Brendan in for more work.Thanks for everything!!

Great deal.  I was able to negotiate quality of components and thus costings to suit our needs. It was good to be able to keep the money in the local area. No BS or shenanigans with the quoting like most of the southern Qld and interstate based mobs either. All running well, good results from both panels and inverter.  The quoter was the installer which was a bonus and great to deal with. No problems recommending Energy Base. Happy as Larry.

I found Energy Base very good & knows a lot about different solar systems. Gave us a few different ways to go on solar power systems, with roof area & the best way for us to go to save money with that solar power system.
Brendon did some additional switch board repairs to up grade to current standards and changed tariffs etc to suit our needs.
I would not hesitate in recommending Energy Base to anyone thinking of installing solar.Service, Value, Experience, Honest, Reliable they have it all.

Turned up promptly on the inst.date made 2 months prior. No salesman crap talk.Was quoted an extra 600&700 by two large southern companies for work on Meter box.Made out it was a big deal.Brendan did it in about 1hr,and was incl in the price. Came to about the same all up in the end.Very neat work,without any dramas.One happy customer!

Very good experience. Brendan knows his stuff. He keeps up with any changes in legislation and wiring rules. All forms, paperwork and dealings with Ergon are completed by Energy Base.  Nothing to worry about.  The  quality of the installation is excellent.  I am happy to recommend Energy Base for solar generation systems. Being a local company, questions answered and support are close by. Paul.

Brendan from Energy Base was very knowledgeable and informative at our first meeting.  Our dealings with him through the entire process was great and we are very happy with the installation job carried out by Brendan and his team and our solar panels are busy working for us.

Brendan was very professional in every possible way, always replied promptly to emails and I trusted him, which to me is very important.  Not like the big companies with their flash powerpoint presentations, just down to earth, and the most important to me, we dealt with a local company.
Outstanding experience dealing with Energy Base Solar. Have recommended company to several friends already.
Brendon at Energy Base was very helpful with everything I needed and had by far the best price of every place I searched. I was also pleased to find a local with what I need.

From paying deposit it was 4 weeks to grid meter, installed and job completed. Excellent communication, and well worth the excercise of shopping locally at Mackay, Central Queensland .Price was competetive with quotes received from Brisbane and Inter State .

Energy Base gave us all the information and answered all questions required for us to make a informed decision and completed the job at the quoted price.The team that installed the system (the owner of the company being a member) completed the job professionally and to a standard we are very happy to show anybody the job and have recommended Energy Base to others.The system has been operating for three weeks and production is above the average stated in the system design summary we received with the original quote and has cut our day time electricity use to zero.At this time we are not connected to the grid as Ergon have not changed our meter yet so we do not know what we are exporting.

I appreciated the professional attitude and attention to detail that Brendan handled everything with.  I was kept informed every step of the way and all my questions were answered.  I have been more than satisfied with the experience.

For a local Mackay Region business can highly recommend Energy Base. 3 weeks from deposit to completion. Proprietor personally involved throughout from quote to completed installation. Quality hardware, price comparable with national companies. Overall, a rewarding experience.
A good experience.
